items.text: David Sheppard is a member of the Evergreen Park Elementary School District 124 school board. He had a 28-year career in law enforcement, working in corrections and investigations before becoming chief of the Robbins Police Department. He also served in the U.S. Navy.

sentences.text: David Sheppard is a member of the Evergreen Park Elementary School District 124 school board.
He had a 28-year career in law enforcement, working in corrections and investigations before becoming chief of the Robbins Police Department.
He also served in the U.S. Navy.

items.text: Sheppard has proposed a 30-day accountability report before state funds are distributed and a plan to cut homeowners’ property taxes by 60 percent. He has criticized efforts to keep federal immigration enforcement away from polling places, saying no law enforcement agency should be restricted from enforcing the law. In a 2022 candidate survey, he said his goals were to reduce crime and support police, as well as preserve parental rights.
